docs.summary: User-pluggable light falloff model. Photonic queries [`Evaluate`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.Sampling.IAttenuation~Evaluate) for the unitless multiplier applied to a light's radiance at a given surface distance.
docs.remarks: Implement your own for any specific falloff curve you need (physically-plausible inverse square, smooth normalised quadratic, hard cutoff, etc).
